builds.name: Summon Tibbers impact ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Summon Tibbers impact within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Summon Tibbers impact within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 summon hit is400+0.75 AP; R passive supplies20% magic penetration, so AP and MR penetration strengthen initial impact. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowflame provides15 flat MR penetration and20% eligible low-health magic amplification. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. One initial summon hit only.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Summon Tibbers impact tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Annie gains [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2) × 100]% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing [150 / 275 / 400 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. For the next [45] seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for [8 / 12 / 16 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.
